rootCauseIdentified.primary: Read-only mount at /workspace/.config/opencode prevents package installation and config writes
rootCauseIdentified.secondary: ConfigMap uses ${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY} syntax which doesn't work in static JSON
rootCauseIdentified.tertiary: K8s deployment doesn't use devbob-entrypoint.sh initialization script

investigationFindings.finding: SDK module can be imported and initialized

changesRequired.changeMade: Remove read-only mount of /workspace/.config/opencode OR change mount path to /workspace/opencode-config and update config loading
changesRequired.reason: Read-only mount prevents opencode from writing package.json and installing SDK packages, causing ProviderInitError
changesRequired.impactAnalysis: Breaking change - requires pod restart. Alternative: Use emptyDir with initContainer to copy config.

changesRequired.changeMade: Remove ${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY} template syntax - environment variable substitution doesn't work in static JSON mounted as ConfigMap
changesRequired.reason: Static JSON files cannot perform environment variable substitution. The apiKey field ends up as literal string '${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY}' instead of actual key value.
changesRequired.impactAnalysis: Config change requires ConfigMap update. Provider will use env var directly instead of from config file.

changesRequired.changeMade: Change command from 'opencode acp' to '/configs/devbob-entrypoint.sh acp' to use initialization script
changesRequired.reason: Entrypoint script creates proper opencode config with environment variable substitution before starting opencode
changesRequired.impactAnalysis: Requires /configs/devbob-entrypoint.sh to be available in container image or mounted as ConfigMap

changesRequired.changeMade: Add initContainer to copy ConfigMap to writable location before main container starts
changesRequired.reason: Allows ConfigMap to be mounted read-only while still providing writable config directory for opencode
changesRequired.impactAnalysis: Non-breaking change. InitContainer copies /workspace/.config/opencode-readonly to /workspace/.config/opencode before app starts.

steps.code:
initContainers:
- name: setup-config
  image: busybox
  command:
  - sh
  - -c
  - |
    mkdir -p /workspace/.config/opencode
    cp /config-readonly/opencode.json /workspace/.config/opencode/opencode.json
    # Substitute environment variables
    sed -i "s/\${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY}/$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/g" /workspace/.config/opencode/opencode.json
    sed -i "s/\${METABOB_API_KEY}/$METABOB_API_KEY/g" /workspace/.config/opencode/opencode.json
  volumeMounts:
  - name: workspace
    mountPath: /workspace
  - name: config
    mountPath: /config-readonly
    readOnly: true
  env:
  - name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
    valueFrom:
      secretKeyRef:
        name: devbob-secrets
        key: anthropic-api-key
  - name: METABOB_API_KEY
    valueFrom:
      secretKeyRef:
        name: devbob-secrets
        key: metabob-api-key

volumeMounts:
- mountPath: /workspace
  name: workspace
# Remove the read-only mount - config is now in /workspace/.config/opencode

volumes:
- name: workspace
  persistentVolumeClaim:
    claimName: devbob-pvc
- name: config
  configMap:
    name: devbob

optionB.name: Remove config file requirement
optionB.description: Modify opencode to work without config file when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is in environment

optionC.name: Use environment variables instead of config file
optionC.description: Pass all config via environment variables
cons: Large config is cumbersome as env vars
